Real user FKs exist only on api_keys.user_id, invite_codes.created_by/used_by, device_authorization.user_id; saved_searches.owner = mutable display_name string. TENANCY: NO org/tenant/workspace concept anywhere (grep-confirmed) → multi-tenant is from-scratch. GROUPING: Project is FLAT — no parent/child, no project_groups, no project_tags (only document_tags).
